scope: Surgical unit proof for private choice source capture, atomic cases/outbox staging, and protected historical reads; no nominal UI, native, integration, financial approval or criterion acceptance is granted.
fixture_rules: Admit a real private UI lease through createSfUiAuthority; use its Request, binding and revalidation.
Use actual canonical product state/C08 persistence for transaction and no-effects assertions where the concrete factory permits; keep controlled boundary doubles explicit.

Construct an actual coherent DecisionCase, ChoiceRecord and choice-recorded ledger event through canonical helpers where available; bind source refs and protected projection bytes by canonical digests.
Use canonical source lifecycle records for physical continuity; distinguish a material edit from physical replacement.
Use actual capture/reader, enqueueSfLedgerEvent, sfChoiceSourceCaptureDigest and createSfRecordHistory implementations; do not recreate their validators in test helpers.
Assert public outcomes and persisted effects, not provisional reason strings or an exact incidental call count.

checks: A valid UI zero-operation/assumption-free Planner choice captures every distinct referenced Planner version with the original authorized projection.
Returned capture and stored outbox are detached from input/projector aliases; mutating a returned object cannot rewrite committed history.
Unsupported structural shapes return ok[] without inventing a capture; an eligible denied/stale source does not downgrade to ok[].
One actual choice and matching ledger event stage a capture in the same cases+outbox C08 commit; the digest binds actual event, choice, writer, access revision, policy and creation time.
A capture denial, invalid capture, or post-await authority drift commits neither new choice nor outbox capture.
Exact replay preserves the original capture and performs no historical enrichment; legacy entries remain without capture.
Incomplete, duplicate, foreign or mismatched source records cannot be enqueued as a valid capture.
The protected reader resolves the exact original ref/projection from a matching current case, actual choice and actual ledger/outbox event.
Missing capture or missing bound case/choice/event returns unavailable without synthesizing from today's source.
Tampered choice, event, eventRef, capture bytes or capture digest is refused.
Writer/access/policy/time metadata tampering is refused even if the visible source ref is unchanged.
Case or capture changed between initial and final reads is refused; authorization is reopened before egress.
Absent, replaced or aborted Request is refused.
Headers, binding, private UI lease or current case authorization changed during an await is refused.
Current ACL revocation prevents historical read even when protected original bytes and their digest remain intact.
An actual material edit of the same physical Planner record returns historical original bytes plus the current ref and precise differences.
Physical replacement/delete-recreate of the same logical record id does not inherit the old source's protected capture.
Current projection or original capture drift between continuity observations is refused.
Reading historical bytes performs no source mutation, grant renewal, Atlas publication, approval or Apply.
A competing SQLite writer created outside the reader ALS context changes choice/outbox/captured-source during final revalidation.
Canonical held C08 prevents the writer from entering; a non-held egress must refuse if the change completes before revalidation returns.
After the competing commit, a new protected read cannot return the old capture.
The original 47 test bodies and assertions remain verbatim; no sleeps, timeouts or UI replacements.

api_bindings.event_integrity: SfChoiceSourceCapture.eventDigest = digestSfValue(actual full CaseLedgerEvent); included in captureDigest

limits: This is a proposed matrix, not a report of tests executed or passed.
The final test file must be reconciled to the root's concrete capture/reader module before dispatch.
Tests may use controlled invalid boundary responses to exercise refusal; these fixtures are not replacements for the five nominal UI journeys.
No source policy, grants, roles, original assertions, scenario identities, timeout or workflow is changed.
